About This Game

Six children have been kidnapped and taken into the dark woods.

Beyond the last lantern lies a forest the community has feared for generations. Strange creatures move between the trees, armed outlaws stalk the forgotten paths, and somewhere in the darkness, a hidden cult prepares to complete its ritual.

You must choose a leader, assemble an expedition, select the equipment they will carry, and enter the forest before it is too late.

Mature Content Description

The developers describe the content like this:

The game contains dark fantasy violence, combat involving weapons and supernatural creatures, descriptions of injuries and death, and scenes involving a cult. The story includes six children being forcibly kidnapped, threatened, and placed in danger. The game also contains frightening imagery and bleak horror themes. There is no sexual content or graphic gore.

AI Generated Content Disclosure

The developers describe how their game uses AI Generated Content like this:

Generative AI is used in both pre-generated and live-generated content. AI-assisted tools were used during development to create the game’s artwork, music, and sound effects. The game also uses live generative AI to produce narrative text during gameplay in response to predefined player choices, combat outcomes, character conditions, and equipment selections. All pre-generated assets were reviewed and selected by the developer before being included in the game.
